findings.conclusion: Yora reports actual map making and revision, not only an intention. Missing large wall output is a narrower fact than no map.
Concrete tool friction is drawing/erasing in general editors; paper/pencil/scan workflow is the chosen alternative. Generator uptake remains unmeasured.
Campaign/edition attribution needs article-level evidence: earlier DND5 play and later DND3 plans do not confirm Dragonbane sessions.
Dormir remains a single indexed commission report with materials attribution. No session or adoption inference is supported.
